An '''Automated Weapon''' is a [[Weapon]] subtype (printed '''Weapon — Automated'''). It is typically deployed at a site (mines, seekers, projectors) rather than on a character or starship, and often detonates or fires without a warrior using it.

Other weapon subtypes: [[Character Weapon]], [[Starship Weapon]], [[Artillery Weapon]], [[Vehicle Weapon]].

Premiere examples: [[Timer Mine]], [[Tagge Seeker]], [[Tarkin Seeker]], [[Laser Projector]].
